C S 474

Introduction to Deep Learning

Computer ScienceCollege of Computational, Mathematical, & Physical Sciences
Course Information

Course Description

Understand theory and practice of deep learning, drawing material from machine vision, machine translation, dynamical systems, audio processing, neural computing and human perception. Learn supporting mathematical concepts, including linear algebra, stochastic optimization, and hardware acceleration.

When Taught

Fall and Winter

Min

3

Fixed/Max

3

Fixed

3

Fixed

0
01499-002 or

12181-001

Title

Analyze Deep Learning

Learning Outcome

Theory and practice of modern deep learning and associated software frameworks. A broad look at the field, drawing on material from machine vision, machine translation, dynamical systems, audio processing, neural computing and human perception. Supporting mathematical concepts are also covered, including linear algebra, stochastic optimization, and hardware acceleration. This fulfills the Intellectually Enlarging aim by requiring students to master technical "depth" and rigorous logic across diverse computational domains.
